name: National Food Security Mission (NFSMCSS)
eligibility_facts: benefits limited to 5 hectares per season
small/marginal and women farmers receive earmarked allocations
hard_exclusions: none stated as universal; district/crop targeting applies
questions: Which crop are you growing or planning to grow?
temporal_note: Area/district and intervention eligibility is program-specific.

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: benefits limited to 5 hectares per season

description.en: Assistance under mission components is limited to five hectares per farmer in a season.
description.or: ମିଶନର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଅଂଶରେ ପ୍ରତି ଋତୁରେ ପ୍ରତି ଚାଷୀଙ୍କୁ ସର୍ବାଧିକ ପାଞ୍ଚ ହେକ୍ଟର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସହାୟତା ମିଳେ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: small/marginal and women farmers receive earmarked allocations

description.en: Allocations are earmarked for small, marginal, and women farmers; this is a priority rule, not a universal exclusion.
description.or: କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର, ନାମମାତ୍ର ଏବଂ ମହିଳା ଚାଷୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅର୍ଥ ବରାଦ୍ଦ ରଖାଯାଏ; ଏହା ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ନିୟମ, ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବହିଷ୍କାର ନୁହେଁ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] none stated as universal; district/crop targeting applies

description.en: Availability for the relevant crop and district must be confirmed separately.
description.or: ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ଫସଲ ଏବଂ ଜିଲ୍ଲା ପାଇଁ ଯୋଜନା ଉପଲବ୍ଧ କି ନାହିଁ, ତାହା ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।
